text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the debut race has finally 
arrived. As for Inari One—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It's finally, finally, finally starting! 
Lady Inari's grand brawl tourney, her very 
first battle!
choice_data_list: You're fully fired up, aren't you!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Get outta here! That goes without sayin'! 
A good start is everything! Trippin' right 
out of the gate would totally ruin the 
mood!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'll give you a real good look. At the 
stylish running style of a true Edokko!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you watch from the best seat in 
the house, Boss! You're gonna see Lady 
Inari's flashy grand opening fireworks!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Make sure you watch from the front row 
too, Big Sis! See the flashy first 
fireworks of the great Inari!"
